seoTitle: Connect PayPal to eBay for Checkout and Selling
metaDescription: Learn how to link PayPal to eBay for buyer checkout, plus how sellers can use Zapier to automate PayPal invoices and notifications for eBay orders.
intro: Even though eBay now runs most transactions through Managed Payments, PayPal can still be linked for personal purchases, checkout, and automation via Zapier. This guide covers adding PayPal as a funding method for buying and setting up a Zapier workflow that connects PayPal to your eBay order flow.

steps.heading: Link PayPal as a funding method
steps.body: Add your PayPal account in eBay's payment settings so it's available as a checkout option for purchases.

steps.heading: Set PayPal as your default
steps.body: If you prefer PayPal for buying, you can set it as your default payment method so it's selected automatically at checkout.

steps.heading: Use PayPal at checkout when available
steps.body: PayPal will appear as an option during checkout on listings where it's supported, letting you complete purchases through your PayPal balance or linked cards.

steps.heading: Connect Zapier for sellers
steps.body: Sellers can integrate PayPal with eBay's order flow using Zapier to automate tasks like invoices, notifications, or backups between the two platforms.

steps.heading: Build a Zapier workflow
steps.body: Set up triggers in Zapier so new eBay orders can automatically generate PayPal invoices or notify you, saving manual tracking work.

steps.heading: Track every transaction
steps.body: Use the combination of eBay order history and PayPal or Zapier logs to keep a clear record of every sale or payment.

faq.question: Can I still use PayPal to buy on eBay?
faq.answer: Yes, PayPal can be linked as a funding method and used at checkout on listings where it's supported.

faq.question: Does eBay still support PayPal for sellers?
faq.answer: eBay now primarily uses Managed Payments for sellers, but Zapier can bridge PayPal with your eBay order flow for automation.

faq.question: What can I automate with Zapier and PayPal?
faq.answer: You can automate tasks like generating invoices, sending notifications, or backing up order and payment data between eBay and PayPal.

faq.question: Is this method suitable for dropshippers?
faq.answer: Yes, hybrid sellers and dropshippers can use the PayPal and Zapier combination to simplify tracking sales and payments.

faq.question: Do I need a Zapier account?
faq.answer: Yes, connecting PayPal to eBay's order flow for automation requires setting up workflows in Zapier.
